title: I HOPE TO MEET YOU ALL IN GLORY
author: Emma Pitt
stanzas: I hope to meet you all in glory, When the storms of life are o'er; I hope to tell you the dear old story, On the blessed shining shore
I hope to meet you all in glory, By the tree of life so fair; I hope to praise our dear Redeemer for the grace that brought me there.
I hope to meet you all in glory, Round the Savior's throne above; I hope to join the ransomed army Singing now redeeming love.
chorus: On the shining, shore, On the golden strand, In our Father's home, In the happy land: I hope to meet you there, A crown of vict'ry wear, In glory.
